quarterly_data.quarter: Generate Biomedicines press release: Generate Biomedicines and Zealand Pharma Enter (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Zealand Pharma: Generate entered a multi-target strategic collaboration and license agreement with Zealand Pharma A/S to design and develop multispecific protein therapeutics for obesity and other metabolic diseases using The Generate Platform. Generate uses its generative AI platform to lead research through lead-candidate selection; Zealand Pharma assumes responsibility for subsequent clinical development, regulatory submissions and worldwide commercialization. For the two initial programs (with an option to add a third), Generate receives $30 million upfront and up to $35 million in early preclinical milestones, and is eligible for total milestones of nearly $1.2 billion, including development, regulatory and commercial milestones, plus tiered royalties on worldwide net sales. The deal extends The Generate Platform into obesity and other metabolic diseases. CEO Mike Nally: the teams will first define what a great medicine looks like for each of the two initial programs, then use The Generate Platform to design multispecific candidates that meet or exceed that profile.
quarterly_data.figure: $30 million upfront; up to $35 million early preclinical milestones; total milestones of nearly $1.2 billion; two initial programs
